tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image and return a transparent PNG/WebP, or place the subject on white, a colour, a gradient or a built-in scene, optionally at a marketplace size (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, eBay, Instagram). Costs 1 credit (hd 2, ultra 4); free credits export up to 2 MP.

tools.name: erase_objects
tools.description: Remove objects from a photo by describing them, for example "the cables on the desk" or "the person on the left". The rest of the image is kept pixel for pixel. Costs 25 credits (enhance 40, paid credits).

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale an image 2× (source up to 16 MP, 2 credits) or 4× (source up to 4 MP, 4 credits) with Real-ESRGAN. Needs paid credits.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Show the NukeBG credit balance (free, subscription and paid) and plan for this API key.
